title: Concerto
identity: Jaromír Weinberger, Concerto for E-flat alto saxophone and orchestra, commissioned by Cecil Leeson. Piano score was completed in 1940 and its premiere was delayed until 1946; Keiser’s current performance edition incorporates post-premiere revisions by Tristan Willems, with orchestra and piano-reduction formats.

evidence.claim: Keiser describes commission, completion/premiere timeline, revisions, performance edition, and available piano reduction.
Ball State University archival description identifies Leeson’s manuscript E-flat alto saxophone part and notes composer-requested phrasing/tempos and revisions.

collection_flag: Commissioned for saxophonist Cecil Leeson; an archival performance edition reconciles post-premiere revisions.

listening.description: ORT page identifies a first-movement premiere recording by Christopher Creviston with the Czech National Symphony Orchestra, Tristan Willems conducting.
listening.verification: Recording metadata located; playback not auditioned.

gaps: No current piano-reduction notation inspected; exact solo range and technical demands remain unknown.
